lead: `Core\Config` never answers for an `[[app]]` block's `mode` or `origin`, so an example built on either prints `(unset)` while the setting is in force.
body: `Snapshot::build` lifts those two onto the snapshot's own fields and drops `app` from the folded table (`crates/nvs-config/src/snapshot.rs:158`), so a block is readable only through its `[app.limits]` and `[app.capabilities]` — as `limits.*` and `capabilities.*`, never under an `app.` prefix. Show a block through one of those, or through behaviour the way `examples/routes.nvs` does.
